The Jigawa State Command of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps has arrested two men for allegedly vandalising and stealing streetlight cables in Birnin-Kudu Local Government Area of the state. The command’s spokesperson, Badaruddeen Tijjani, disclosed in a statement on Tuesday that armoured cables measuring about 6.5 metres and valued at N117,000 were recovered from the suspects. According to the statement, credible intelligence received by the command indicated that the cables were vandalised on November 10, 2026. Tijjani identified the suspects as Aliyu Yau, 35, a plumber, and Mus’ab Yusuf, 20. He explained that, acting on the intelligence, the Divisional Officer, Birnin-Kudu Division, CSC A. S. Adam, mobilised his men and arrested the suspects on November 22, 2026. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. During preliminary investigations, the suspects reportedly confessed to their involvement in the crime, the statement noted. “The suspects also told investigators that the quantity of cable vandalised was far more than what was recovered,” Tijjani said. The NSCDC Jigawa State Commandant, Kabiru Ingawa, commended the Divisional Officer and his personnel for their prompt response and vigilance. The command’s spokesperson quoted the commandant as reiterating the Corps’ commitment to protecting critical national assets against vandalism and theft. He also urged members of the public to remain vigilant and report suspicious activities to the nearest NSCDC office or other security agencies. The command assured residents that it would continue to intensify efforts to safeguard public infrastructure and bring offenders to justice. Salisu Kabuga
